summary: # here.now API Reference Base URL: `https://here.now` ## Authentication Two modes: - **Authenticated**: include `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>` header. - **Anonymous**: omit the header entirely. Publishes expire in 24 hours with lower limits. ### Optional client attribution header You can include an optional header on publish calls: - `X-HereNow-Client: <agent>/<tool>` Examples:
type: skills
tags: skills-sh, skills-sh-all-time
